move_band_note: unsigned magnitude band, right-skewed; the implied move is roughly one standard deviation, not a cap
early_prediction: Panel leans mildly bullish (mean score +15, all seven personas positive but none at Lean-Up strength) on a beat-and-raise setup, but with too little conviction for a directional call; expect a print judged mainly on the size of the FY27 guide raise and GTV growth against a 13.14% implied move that looks rich versus the 9.09% historical mean; main caveat is sector-wide multiple compression that has sold good SaaS prints outright this year even on strong numbers.
red_team_survival_note: The red-team case (guide-implied H2 deceleration to ~15% y/y vs 25% just printed, plus a software-sector de-rating that has punished beats at Salesforce and Workday) produced the panel's lowest score (+8) but did not flip sign -- even the skeptic leans mildly positive, muted mainly by reversal risk (55) rather than direction. The thesis survives as a live tail risk (reversal risk 45-62 across all seven personas) rather than a refutation; it is the main reason the panel is confident there is no strong edge, not confident of a direction.
